no-restricted-syntax.message: Arabic-Indic digits (٠-٩) are never rendered by the app — write Latin digits and format through AR_NUM_LOCALE / AR_DATE_LOCALE from @/lib/format/numerals. A parser that must ACCEPT Arabic-Indic input is the exception: disable this rule on that line with a comment saying why.
